name: Liate Development Environment
postCreateCommand: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.zshrc && echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && bun install
